title: Silver Bridge collapse: drowning victims hear numbers
place_text: Silver Bridge, Point Pleasant (said as Pennsylvania)

tellings.quote: a sudden they heard number 3004 number 3,486 number 3,486 wake up wake up and they like came back to life

plain: When the Silver Bridge at Point Pleasant collapsed in 1967, some people drowning in the river are said to have heard voices calling out numbers, like "number 3,486", and "wake up, wake up", and then came back to life. A philosopher named Jason Jorjani tells this, drawing on the writer John Keel, and places the bridge in Pennsylvania. He tells it as a sign of strange outside forces around the disaster.
